title: Nice Variety of Items
text: Nice Variety of Items. I love decorating with tiered trays. This Christmas I plan to have 2 different trays. One will be a traditional Christmas themed one and the other will be a Grinch themed tray. This set has a nice variety of items. The items are colorful and vibrant. The images were printed well. They definitely look mass produced rather than hand crafted, but that's okay. This will be a good start to my Grinch tray!
